summary: Backend-only testing of the new recurring weekly schedule (class_templates) + Schedule Exceptions feature for Maxenergy. Created /app/backend/tests/test_recurring_schedule.py with 17 targeted tests covering all 7 request items — ALL 17 PASSED (100%). Verified: /api/classes?days=365 returns weekly-recurring virtual instances with '{template_id}__YYYY-MM-DD' ids plus by-appointment classes; QLD Term 3 (2026-09-19..2026-10-05) hides Kids category while Adults still run; GET /api/classes/{virtual_id} resolves and returns 404 on blocked Kids dates; POST /api/bookings materializes a real class doc for a virtual id and rejects blocked Kids dates (404); admin Schedule Exceptions CRUD works incl. single-date default, range, active toggle, list metadata (categories/class_names), auth 401/403; admin recurring template CRUD via /api/admin/classes with weekday+time derivation from start_at; POST /api/admin/classes/{tmpl_id}/cancel returns 400 with helpful 'recurring / Closed Date / exception' message; regression /api/bookings and /api/admin/overview.bug_reports_open still work. Test data (TEST_ templates/exceptions/bookings) all cleaned up — verified via direct Mongo check.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8494 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; consider modularising (classes/bookings/admin/exceptions).
_generate_instances loads templates + exceptions + all materialised classes on every /api/classes call — fine at current scale but consider caching if timetable becomes hot.

_resolve_class does not verify the parsed date's weekday actually matches the template's weekday (e.g. tmpl_muay-thai_kids_1_1700__2026-09-21 where 09-21 is Monday but tmpl weekday might be Tue). Current callers only build ids from real occurrences so it works, but a hand-crafted mismatched date/weekday would still return a virtual instance rather than 404. Low-risk since exceptions cover Kids and duplicate guard exists on booking.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test created 2 TEST_ exceptions + 1 TEST_ recurring template + 1 booking; all were deleted/cancelled in the same run and verified absent from Mongo after run.
